response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced software engineer with strong full-stack, Dlang, and web development skills, but falls significantly short of the mandatory requirements for this role. They lack the required 5-10 years of hands-on C++ experience on Windows, having only 7 months of professional C/C++ experience from 2014-2015. Furthermore, they do not possess the necessary deep domain expertise in Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking, making them unsuitable for this specific backend C++ financial systems position.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience with strong architectural and full-stack skills.
Demonstrated expertise in CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and test-driven development.
Brief exposure to the financial sector through previous work at RIDE Capital.
concerns: Lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ development experience, with only a short stint in 2014-2015.
Missing required deep domain expertise in Fixed Income, Derivatives, or Capital Markets.
Primary technical focus is on web technologies (Node.js, TypeScript) and Dlang rather than Windows-based C++ environments.
